analogs.covers: Almost everything: a gentle giant filter feeder on long migrations, curious, harmless, hunted by others
Parenting: the father alone guards huge swarms of young

headline: A gentle whale shark on an endless migration loop, where the fathers raise the young.

setting.label: Open-sea migration loop
setting.note: Follows a great loop through the north-eastern seas (Kelp Vale, Coastal Bluffs, Scale Lake, Palm Islands, Castaway Isle, the Stonebed shoals, the mudflats and back), plus fixed courtship and nursery grounds.

playsLike: You are an Apex-sized filter feeder that eats only krill along its migration path and never hunts other players. Adults are solitary; males raise massive batches of young and defend them, while females migrate alone and form temporary bonds on the way. You are passive: you only defend yourself (1 engaged) and respect forfeits. You watch other species from a distance. Many hunters want you: Tylosaurus, Kaiwhekea, Eurhinosaurus, Spinosaurus.

why.text: Feeds exclusively on krill while migrating, like whale sharks and basking sharks (official inspiration).
Passive, only defends itself, and does not continue fights after a forfeit.
Nomadic, may migrate communally with others without grouping. Whale sharks travel vast distances and gather at feeding hotspots.
Incredibly curious about other species, observes them from a distance and leaves if unwelcome.
Only males raise the offspring, migrating alongside and protecting them. A bowfin father guards his fry the same way (official inspiration).

notLike: Whale sharks give birth to live young and give no parental care; Leedsichthys fathers guard huge nursery groups.
